tasks.label: Jekyll Serve
tasks.command: mkdir -p $HOME/.jekyll-gems && podman run --rm --volume="$PWD:/srv/jekyll:Z" --volume="$HOME/.jekyll-gems:/usr/local/bundle:Z" --publish 4000:4000 -it docker.io/jekyll/jekyll:latest sh -c "bundle install && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --livereload"
